behavior: FINAL97 source coordinates each20bit, integer12bit<<8; frozen NMS already RNE scales once. No second rounding.
Nonzero fractional bits are malformed display input: skip that box only, never modify original table or invent rounded geometry.
Clamp integer ends to width1280/height720. x0>=x1 or y0>=y1 means no paint, not table error or removed result.
Half-open1px outline: x0/x1-1 verticals, y0/y1-1 horizontals; width1/height1 remain valid.
person0 green00ff00, vehicle1 cyan00ffff; person wins cross-class overlap; white AGE glyphs have final priority.
Only one1280x18 per-line endpoint map: word{point_vehicle,point_person,delta_vehicle_signed8,delta_person_signed8}. Not a fourth97x64 full table.
On horizontal-border rows add+1 at x0 and-1 at x1; skip x1==1280 terminal event. Other inside rows OR point bits at x0 and x1-1, dedup if equal.
Each entry FETCH->READ0->WRITE0->READ1->WRITE1, even skipped entries; at most64 entries. Async table read, one owner.
Native distributed RAM async read. Read stages never write; write stages read dummy(write_address XOR1), so no same-address read/write semantics or forwarding assumed.
Every active pixel consumes current x event then uses9bit signed prefix sum (range0..64). Clear previous x after that read; DEfall clears the last pixel. This occurs even when draw_valid=0.
Cold/common reset and each SOF explicitly clear all1280 words in vertical blank, no bitstream initialization. No painting before clear and complete preparation.
SOF resets display coordinates and row-ready; wait a blank edge after table NBA bank switch before scanning. Normal next rows start after DEfall last-pixel clear.
If preparation is late at DErise, cancel its writes, suppress the entire line and set sticky fault; never stall video or resume painting midrow.
Preparation completeness is independent of draw permission; current live table.draw_valid controls paint, not a SOF-latched copy.
constraints: Only independent box_overlay_joint_20261016 writes. No production/video chain replacement, TD, training, bitstream, board, Flash or timing exceptions.
No new source identity/publisher/slotcredit/DDR implementation. Existing actual C9 pipeline/table/time reused read-only in joint test.
Injected boxes test renderer, not recognition. Real7box path uses frozen HEAD112 -> correct vendor ROM -> actual postprocess/publisher/table -> renderer.
Functional pass does not prove physical mapping/timing, full67 layers, DDR loop,1FPS or precision.
